infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: OVOA connects to your ES100 recorder over Bluetooth to pull in what it captured.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: OVOA doesn't look at your photos. iOS asks for this line because the file tools OVOA uses can save to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: OVOA uses your iPhone's speech recognition to hear what you say to it, its name, and your recordings. Your voice is recognised on your iPhone, or by Apple's speech service on iPhones that can't do it themselves. It's never sent to OVOA or the AI companies.

plugins.motionPermission: OVOA counts your steps and detects falls using motion data.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: OVOA includes your location in emergency alerts.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: OVOA learns the places you go, like home and work, so it can remind you of things when you arrive or leave. Your location stays in your OVOA account and is kept for 14 days.

plugins.contactsPermission: OVOA looks up, adds, and edits contacts when you ask the assistant to.

plugins.calendarPermission: OVOA reads and adds calendar events when you ask the assistant to.
plugins.remindersPermission: OVOA reads and adds reminders when you ask the assistant to.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: OVOA reads your steps, heart rate, sleep, and workouts to answer your questions about them.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: OVOA does not write to Apple Health. iOS requires this message because the Health library OVOA uses can save data.

plugins.microphonePermission: OVOA uses the microphone when you talk to it or record a note, and listens for its name on the phone while the orb is on. Your iPhone turns what you say into words; only the words you say to OVOA are sent, never the sound.

plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: OVOA uses your iPhone's speech recognition to hear what you say to it, its name, and your recordings. Your voice is recognised on your iPhone, or by Apple's speech service on iPhones that can't do it themselves. It's never sent to OVOA or the AI companies.
